thread:
eva liu: Quick check — seeing KV cache latency spikes in the token-attribution pipeline this morning, ~20-40ms extra p50. Anyone owning the ingest/batching changes that landed last night? :eyes:

metrics-bot: ALERT: token-attrib.kv_cache.latency.p50 crossed 65ms at 2026-03-17T09:12:08Z. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood/instr/token-attrib (alert id: A-9821)

dave wong: I pushed a batching tweak in the ingest service (PR #4582) to increase batch_size to 128 for better throughput. rolled at 02:30am PT. Could be related.

carol ng: yep that was me. The change also switched to the new router shard logic to reduce RPC fanout. I didn't expect latency regressions, might be kv hot-sharding.

benji ramirez: pinging the infra team—can we get heap/queue metrics around the kernel that serves kv? I can run a narrow query:```sql
SELECT timestamp, p50, p95 FROM instr.kv_cache WHERE service='token-attrib' AND timestamp > now() - interval '60 minutes';
```

alice park: I'll take the first look on the runbook + rollback plan. If it's the batching param, we can revert to 64. I can open a quick revert PR.

eva liu: Thanks. Ownership-wise: ingest service (dave + carol), infra metrics and dashboards (benji), runbook & rollback (alice). Confirm? :thumbsup:

dave wong: confirmed. I'll revert batching if we see continued upswing. Monitoring rule: if p50 > 80ms for 5m, auto-rollforward to previous config? maybe too aggressive.

carol ng: adding a short probe in the router to log per-shard latencies for 10min to root-cause. Will post sample logs here. @benji can you correlate with KV op rates?

benji ramirez: on it. grabbing logs now, will post a condensed snapshot.

metrics-bot: NOTE: Deploy bot recorded rollout: ingest-service v1.14.2 -> v1.14.3 (canary 10%) at 02:28am PT by carol ng

carol ng: sample log snippet:```
[2026-03-17T09:10:52Z] router shard=3 op=get p50=42ms p95=180ms ops=220/s
[2026-03-17T09:11:07Z] router shard=7 op=get p50=120ms p95=340ms ops=40/s
```

benji ramirez: correlating with KV side — shard 7 shows higher miss rate and elevated IO wait during the window. Looks like a hot key pattern. Suggest enabling prefix-based KV caching for the noisy keys and reducing batch_size for gets.

alice park: I'll draft the rollback PR and a hotkey mitigation change (prefix cache + shorter ttl) and post links. If we can limit impact in 15-20min that should be fine.

eva liu: timeline ask from product: can we confirm mitigation or rollback within the hour?

dave wong: yes I'll stand by and revert if needed. If alice posts PR, I'll merge after signoff.

alice park: PRs: revert-batch-128 -> https://git.redwood/repo/ingest/pull/4620 ; hotkey-mitigate -> https://git.redwood/repo/ingest/pull/4621 (has short description + test).

carol ng: running the extra probe now, will share delta in ~10m.

benji ramirez: snapshot: shard7 IO wait 9.2ms -> 28ms spike at 09:10-09:12, top keys: user:session:age and prompt:cache:recent -> both high frequency.

eva liu: ok plan: 1) merge revert PR if latency continues for next 10m, 2) deploy hotkey cache change after smoke test, 3) post postmortem with root cause & lessons (assign to ingest + infra). I'll create a ticket and add owners.

dave wong: good. I'll keep watch and update here.

carol ng: probe results: p50 back to normal on shards 3/5, shard 7 still high. running a per-key dump now.

metrics-bot: RECOVERY: token-attrib.kv_cache.latency.p50 returned to 48ms at 2026-03-17T09:23:00Z (auto-resolved alert A-9821)

alice park: since alert resolved, hold off on revert for now. I'll keep the hotkey PR ready for fast deploy if shard7 stays noisy.

benji ramirez: logging suggests a transient spike caused by a client with high fanout on a small keyspace. I'll add a rate-limit rule in the ingress LB for that client id.

carol ng: noted. thanks all. I'll follow up with logs and attach them to the ticket.

eva liu: perfect. I'll file the ticket and tag everyone. Thanks for the quick triage :wave:
